item.title: ‘Smart money is on the Ukrainians’ being behind Alekseyev shooting – Russian affairs expert
item.description: One of Russia’s top generals is in hospital and said to be in a critical condition after he was shot several times by an unknown attacker, inside his apartment building in Moscow. Lieutenant General Vladimir Alekseyev is deputy head of Russia’s military intelligence and is sanctioned by the US and the EU over his role…

item.title: 31 killed in bomb attack on mosque in Pakistani capital
item.description: At least 31 people have been killed and scores injured in a suicide bomb attack at a mosque on the outskirts of the Pakistani capital Islamabad.

item.title: ‘Labour party culture allowed Mandelson so much power’ – Labour MP
item.description: The Labour MP Apsana Begym who is a member of the socialist campaign group of left wing Labour MPs joins us from east London.

item.title: Police search home of Peter Mandelson over Epstein links
item.description: Police have been searching two properties belonging to Lord Mandelson in connection with their investigation into alleged misconduct in public office.

item.title: Trump takes down post with racist imagery of Obamas after outcry
item.description: The White House claimed it was just "an internet meme" and dismissed critics for their "fake outrage".

item.title: Trump ‘violating the law’ by not releasing all of Epstein files – Democratic congressman
item.description: The Democratic congressman Suhas Subramanyam is a member of the House oversight committee and has called on Peter Mandelson and Andrew Mountbatten Windsor to testify.

item.title: Epstein survivor: ‘Virginia Giuffre is an American hero’
item.description: The survivors of Epstein's abuse say they are no closer to justice - despite the latest release of millions of files.

item.title: Gruffalo Granny: Julia Donaldson announces third book in series
item.description: The much loved Gruffalo books are to get another installment as author Julia Donaldson revealed the long awaited third in the series will come out this autumn. item.title: Jon Ruben jailed 23 years for abusing boys at summer camp
item.description: A 76 year old man has been jailed for 23 years and 10 months for sexually abusing boys at a Christian summer camp in Leicestershire, after lacing sweets with sedative drugs purchased on the dark web.

item.title: 16-year-old died after using website promoting suicide
item.description: The parents of a 16-year-old boy who died in 2023 were horrified to find their son had been getting tips from a prolific user of a suicide website in the lead up to his death.
